articles.title: Mahomes exits hurt as Chiefs' playoff hopes end
articles.summary: Chiefs quarterback Patrick Mahomes suffered a left knee injury late in Sunday's loss to the Chargers, which eliminated Kansas City from playoff contention.

articles.title: Bolts' Jefferson ejected, makes obscene gesture
articles.summary: Chargers safety Tony Jefferson was ejected after a helmet-to-helmet hit on Chiefs wide receiver Tyquan Thornton in the fourth quarter Sunday and left the field in frustration, making an obscene gesture toward fans.

articles.title: Ravens standout rookie LB Buchanan hurts knee
articles.summary: Ravens linebacker Teddye Buchanan, who is the team's second-leading tackler, was knocked out of Sunday's game against the Bengals with a knee injury.

articles.title: Bears' Odunze out after aggravating foot injury
articles.summary: Bears wide receiver Rome Odunze did not play in Sunday's 31-3 win over the Cleveland Browns after aggravating his foot injury during pregame warmups.

articles.title: Cardinals WR Baccellia suffers neck injury in loss
articles.summary: Cardinals wide receiver Andre Baccellia was taken to a Houston-area hospital for evaluation after suffering a neck injury Sunday.

articles.title: Sources: Colts' Jones expected back for camp
articles.summary: Daniel Jones underwent surgery that is expected to sideline him for 6-8 months, giving the Colts QB the ability to be fully cleared for the start of next summer's training camp, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: 49ers place injured Aiyuk on reserve/left team list
articles.summary: The 49ers placed Brandon Aiyuk on the reserve/left team list on Saturday, likely ending the receiver's tenure in San Francisco.

articles.title: Cowboys keep CB Diggs on IR for Vikings game
